     """Resolve a fallback include relative to base_dir, confined to root."""
     skip = list(skip or [])
     skip.append(name)

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_include_fallback_escape.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import os
+
+import pytest
+
+from lamina.errors import IncludeError
+from lamina.include.fallback import resolve_fallback_include
+
+
+def test_fallback_rejects_dotdot(tmp_path):
+    (tmp_path / "outside.conf").write_text("[a]\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    (tmp_path / "proj").mkdir()
+    with pytest.raises(IncludeError):
+        resolve_fallback_include(str(tmp_path / "proj"), "../outside.conf", str(tmp_path / "proj"))
+
+
+def test_fallback_rejects_symlink(tmp_path):
+    (tmp_path / "secret").mkdir()
+    (tmp_path / "secret" / "k.conf").write_text("[a]\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    (tmp_path / "proj").mkdir()
+    os.symlink(tmp_path / "secret", tmp_path / "proj" / "link")
+    with pytest.raises(IncludeError):
+        resolve_fallback_include(str(tmp_path / "proj"), "link/k.conf", str(tmp_path / "proj"))
